function.name: python_send_mail
function.description: Sends an email using specified sender and recipient addresses, with a given subject and message content. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

subject.description: The subject line of the email.

message.description: The main content of the email.

cc.description: An array of email addresses to be included in the 'CC' field.

bcc.description: An array of email addresses to be included in the 'BCC' field.

attachments.description: An array of file paths or URLs for attachments.

function.name: get_current_weather
function.description: Retrieves the current weather conditions for a specified location, allowing for a choice between Celsius and Fahrenheit units. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location for which to get the weather, in the format of 'City, State', such as 'San Francisco, CA' or 'New York, NY'.

unit.description: The temperature unit for the weather data.
